name: erdtree
author: SammiBabe666
description: erdtree by SammiBabe666 is an Elden Ring tribute that plays like a small orchestra under the Erdtree. Each encoder brings in one section: blue a choir of spectral voices, green detuned violins and celli, orange Brassophone's horn, and white the distance between them. Each section also animates its own part of the screen: falling leaves, the crown, shafts of light and stars.
credits: The brass voice is Brassophone's, by nick (nvmsocool)
